milestone_full: Layer S continues: 185 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 185/185/185 with a derived fence. The ticket arc (179-183), the crossing arc (64-67) and chapter 185 — a ticket bearing tomorrow’s time at the Central terminus at 00:05 — make the world walkable in both directions; a measured world census computes the bigness from the corpus and deterministic re-entry doors end the old 106-chapter dead end. Production-limit siege: 2,702 credential-stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244 at p50=8 ms. Spring Cloud edge, 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics (password 123) with a real funnel and reader profiles, embedded in-app handbook, contract-enforced English arm. D1577 removed the Clash Verge dependency: all outbound lanes now use direct egress by default, and a proxy is opt-in only. The gpt-6.2-sol API is closed by directive; all recent work is code-and-rules only. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1008 web + 38k AI green.
headline: 185 Hong Kong chapters in three arms · atlas lockstep 185/185/185 · two curated arcs + a measured world census with endless re-entry · production-limit siege 2,702 ALL 429, zero 5xx · Spring Cloud edge + 12 StateGraph lanes · admin funnel + password 123 · Clash-free direct egress · 1008 web + 38k AI green · LLM API closed.
features: D1577/1578: no Clash Verge dependency — LLM, embedding and Wikipedia-facts lanes use direct egress; ambient HTTP(S)_PROXY is ignored, proxy is explicit opt-in; all gates re-verified.
D1576: chapter 185 — at 00:05 a ticket bearing tomorrow’s time is left at the Central terminus; the arc reaches 185 with atlas lockstep 185/185/185.
D1570/D1569: the behavior funnel (view/click/search/read/save shares, weakest transition) and reader profiles reach parity on the live route, not just the demo payload.
D1568: chapter 184 — the coda: at 23:30 the ticket that carried only a time is claimed at the Central terminus.
D1567/D1563: two curated arcs — the ticket arc (179-183) and the crossing arc (64-67) — walkable from any chapter, server-rendered, locale-derived titles, no model or network.
D1560: world census measures the bigness from the corpus itself (chapters, arms, blocks, cards, hours, layers) and deterministic re-entry doors end the 106-chapter dead end.
D1541: siege re-measured at PRODUCTION limits — 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms; read plane 244/244, zero 5xx.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：185 章香港系列三語臂，圖譜鎖步 185/185/185，圍欄由索引推導。票之弧（179–183）、渡之弧（64–67）與第 185 章（00:05 中環終點站，一張寫著明天時間的票）讓世界可以雙向行走；世界普查從語料實測規模，確定性再入門結束舊有 106 章死胡同。生產級限流攻城：2,702 發撞庫全部 429（p50=25ms、零 5xx），讀面 244/244（p50=8ms）。Spring Cloud 邊緣、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 管理員行為分析（真實漏斗與讀者畫像）、嵌入式說明書、契約強制英文臂。D1577 移除 Clash Verge 依賴：所有出站通道默認直連，代理只作為顯式可選項。gpt-6.2-sol API 已按指令關閉，近期工作皆為純程式與規則。verify_all 全綠，web 1008＋AI 38k 全綠。
headline_zh: 185 章香港系列三語臂 · 圖譜鎖步 185/185/185 · 兩條策展弧＋世界普查與無盡再入門 · 生產級攻城 2,702 發全數 429、零 5xx · Spring Cloud 邊緣＋12 條 StateGraph · 管理員漏斗＋密碼 123 · 脫離 Clash 直連上網 · 1008 web＋38k AI 全綠 · 大模型 API 已關閉。
features_zh: D1577／1578：移除 Clash Verge 依賴——LLM、向量與維基資料通道全部直連；忽略環境代理，代理僅為顯式可選項；所有閘門重驗通過。
D1576：第 185 章——00:05，中環終點站留下一張寫著明天時間的票；全系列 185 章，圖譜鎖步 185/185/185。
D1570／D1569：行為漏斗（view/click/search/read/save 份額、最弱轉場）與讀者畫像在 live 路徑與 demo 載荷對等。
D1568：第 184 章尾聲——23:30，那張只寫了時間的票在中環終點站被認走。
D1567／D1563：兩條策展弧——票之弧（179–183）與渡之弧（64–67）——可從任一章走完，服務端渲染、標題隨語言推導、零模型零網絡。
D1560：世界普查從語料實測規模（章節、英文臂、段落、卡片、時辰、層），並以確定性再入門結束 106 章以後的死胡同。
D1541：以生產級限流重測攻城——2,702 發撞庫全數 429（p50=25ms）；讀面 244/244，零 5xx。
